summary: Zoom app development requires domain verification, OAuth configuration, and adherence to a formal review process. Developers must provide test credentials, a test plan, and agree to the Marketplace Developer Agreement to ensure compliance and security before public listing.

reason.text: The process involves multiple technical requirements like domain verification, OAuth redirect setup, and completing the Technical Design documentation.
reason.label: inferred
reason.note: Model judgement from the verified claims in this guide; not tested.

reason.text: Public listing requires a formal review process, including providing test credentials for all roles, submitting a test plan, and addressing feedback from the Marketplace Review Team.

claims.text: Beta apps are restricted to members of the developer's Zoom account.

claims.evidence_quote: To enable developers to test their beta integrations with external Zoom accounts, we provide _authorization URLs_ that you can share with your external users to provide limited access to your beta app.
